posts.title: Designing ARM II
posts.description: Last time, I made a post which went through some general design goals in a semi-structured way. In this post, I want to home in on a concept: the behavior you reward is the behavior you encourage. In other words, I want to look at the player incentives. Since I’m still in the semi-structured phase, I also want to look at some other rules out there and develop opinions. Let’s begin with the former.
